# Gärdenfors Conceptual Space Reference Frame

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:referenceFrameConceptualSpace`](gmeow-referenceFrameConceptualSpace.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/referenceFrameConceptualSpace>
- **Category:** individual
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/sensory-environment`](../../slices/sensory-environment.md)

A generic conceptual space frame after Gärdenfors — domains are convex regions in a similarity metric space. The actual domain-specific axes (colour, taste, shape, etc.) are added per-domain; this seed carries the similarity axis as a placeholder.
